name: np-campaign-alone
_comment: ARM 2 — 'The Emperor Alone'. The §15.4 design amendment says an emperor-led DEFEAT has weight: the aura decays with imperial grip, '+10%' becomes '+9% — his star dims' becomes nothing, and the report says it out loud. Nothing in row NP has PLAYED that. This arm forces the losing case: every marshal is fortified out of the muster (the B1 reason list) so the 10,000-man Guard fights Mack's 52,000 alone, repeatedly. It is also the only realistic route to §7 (capture) in ordinary play. `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).
